C0067.title: Shenzhen Cracks Down on AI Accounts for Exaggerated Claims and Marketing
C0067.summary: The cyberspace affairs authority in Shenzhen reported a crackdown on a batch of AI-operated accounts, some of which spread pseudo-scientific content in the health and wellness sector, engaging in exaggerated claims and marketing in violation of regulations, misleading the public.

references.title: Shenzhen reports typical enforcement cases from the Qinglang special campaigns
